title: Data of normalized derived monoidal comparisons of ringed topoi
statement: Let X be a small site in universe u with a sheaf of commutative rings A and an ordinary unbounded derived category of module sheaves in universe w [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A Site presentation records the closed symmetric tensor structure and its signed representative model [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. For a ringed-topos morphism f [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism], a Lift records a scalar-extension edge [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation] identified with f, its normalized underlying-sheaf Hom bijection, universal derived functors with the K-flat/K-injective transpose formula, and a symmetric strong monoidal structure with tensor and scalar-action unit normalization. Composition, Identity and TwoIso record ordinary and derived comparisons pinned by scalar insertion and representative formulas, their tensor/unit diagrams, and adjunction compatibility, with the full composite counit formula for Composition. System records such lifts for every f, geometric composite and identity witnesses, and these comparisons for every ring-compatible specified geometric path isomorphism. These are witness records; this definition asserts no existence.

proof.text: Define Site by the recorded closed symmetric tensor models. Define Lift by the normalized ordinary scalar insertion, left and right derived functors, and K-flat/K-injective Hom formula. Define Composition, Identity and TwoIso by their representative equations, tensor and unit diagrams, and Hom compatibility. System universally packages these data. These are the original data declarations, unchanged.
